claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceDelta.slot_threshold_tiers
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic Weapon's upcast produces +1 (slot 2), +2 (slots 3–5), +3 (slot 6+). The modify_roll_numeric and modify_damage_numeric atoms carry a DiceDelta for their delta — but DiceDelta has no slot-level scaling mechanism. The only structured alternatives (fixed_dice, proficiency_bonus, ability_modifier, magic_item_rarity_bonus) are all static. Expressing slot-scaled flat bonuses requires a new DiceDelta variant analogous to DiceAmount.threshold_tiers.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3-5 spell slot. The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.
